title: Coordinated hosted API + model catalog Q3 planning and OKRs
creator: Sana Patel
description: This ticket captures the Q3 quarterly roadmap alignment for the Hosted API surface and the Model Catalog. Goal is to produce a prioritized set of initiatives, associated OKRs, milestones, and cross-functional owners so that Engineering, Design, and GTM are aligned for scoped deliveries in Q3. Focus areas: predictability (SLAs/latency SLOs), catalog curation and metadata, rollout/compatibility guarantees, and developer experience improvements for model selection and versioning.
objectives_and_key_results: OKR-1: Improve hosted API reliability and predictability — reduce P95 generation latency by 20% for common 1k-token requests by end of Q3
OKR-2: Catalog usability — increase model selection conversions in docs/console by 30% and reduce support tickets about model compatibility by 50%
OKR-3: Cost/Performance tooling — deliver initial Redwood Optimize integration suggestions for three common workload patterns, targeting 10-15% cost reduction for pilot customers
OKR-4: Rollouts and backward compatibility — ship per-route pinned-version semantics and automated fallback policies with canary guardrails for all hosted API customers
milestones: Milestone 1 (2025-04-15): Complete scoping doc and implementation plan for kernel/latency optimizations (serving runtime dependencies and benchmark targets)
Milestone 2 (2025-05-10): Ship model catalog metadata schema v1 and console model-selection UX prototypes (Design review complete)
Milestone 3 (2025-06-01): Launch canary rollout flow for hosted API with automatic fallback to compatible variants
Milestone 4 (2025-06-20): Pilot Redwood Optimize suggestions with two enterprise customers and collect telemetry for cost improvements
stakeholders: Product: Lena Cho (owner), Miguel Ortega (catalog lead)
Engineering: Priya Raman (runtime), Alex Kim (catalog backend)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Runtime kernel changes introduce regressions in tail latency. Mitigation: gated rollout with end-to-end benchmarks, staged canaries, and automatic rollback policy.
Risk: Catalog metadata additions increase model onboarding friction. Mitigation: provide migration tooling, default mappings, and a lightweight v1 schema prioritizing essential fields.
Risk: Cross-region capacity constraints during rollout. Mitigation: test fallback routing policies and surface capacity signals in Console during pilot.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Benchmarks showing >=15% P95 latency improvement on benchmark harness for targeted workloads and no increase in error rates
2) Catalog metadata schema v1 documented and used by at least 3 internal model integrations
3) Console UI for model selection prototyped and validated with 5 developer interviews
4) Canary rollout flow documented with runbooks and automated rollback triggers
next_steps: Run internal kickoff meeting with Engineering/Design/CS on 2025-03-20 to confirm owners and trade-offs
Finalize API compatibility contract doc and circulate for legal/security review by 2025-03-27
Prioritize detailed work for Milestone 1 in the next engineering cycle and create ENG sub-issues (runtime perf, telemetry)
Design to deliver two console mock flows (quick select and advanced filters) by 2025-04-01
